newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SIG to cooperate with OSTMA on packaging.
newsitem.headline: SIG to cooperate with OSTMA on packaging.

text.p: SIG Schweizerische Industrie-Gesellschaft Holding AG said it had agreed to cooperate on packaging technology with Germany's OSTMA Machinenbau GmbH, effective immediately.
"Both companies will maintain their economic independence under the cooperation agreement," it said in a statement.

"The cooperation accord envisions SIG's acquiring the rights to most of OSTMA's products," it said, adding that this would expand SIG's production programme while giving OSTMA access to SIG's broader marketing and service network.
SIG's packaging operations posted 346 million Swiss francs in sales in 1995, while Cologne-based OSTMA had 30 million marks in turnover.
